business_scope.primary_industry_name: Online Consignment and Secondhand Luxury Goods Retail

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid (U.S.-inspired common-law corporate statute under Title 31 MIRC, RMI Constitution, customary law, and administrative regulations)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Compact of Free Association between the Republic of the Marshall Islands and the United States of America (1986, as amended 2003)
Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations (PACER) Plus

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Title 31 of the Marshall Islands Revised Code (MIRC), Business Corporations Act (1990, as amended), sections 107-112 (incorporation, registered agent, corporate name) and the 2018 beneficial ownership information amendments; Title 22 MIRC Criminal Code (money laundering and terrorist financing offences, as amended); Marshall Islands Banking Act 1991 and the AML/CFT regulations and directives of the Marshall Islands Banking Commission; Counter-Terrorism Act 2002; Mutual Assistance in Criminal Matters Act 2002; and the Registrar of Corporations' Beneficial Ownership Information Directive (as amended), implementing FATF Recommendations as assessed under APG mutual evaluations.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized Consent to Appointment and Undertaking of Incorporator (executed by the founding incorporator)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Licensed Marshall Islands Registered Agent / incorporator's notary public
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization — the Republic of the Marshall Islands is not a Contracting Party to the Hague Apostille Convention; the document is notarized, authenticated by the competent authority of the notarizing jurisdiction, and legalized by the Embassy of the Republic of the Marshall Islands in Washington, D.C.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified true copies of passport, proof of residential address, and source-of-wealth statement for each UBO, director, and shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Passport-issuing authority of the individual's country of nationality and residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization in the issuing jurisdiction, followed by consular legalization via the Embassy of the Republic of the Marshall Islands where required by the Registered Agent's AML/KYC policy or the receiving bank

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: UBO Declaration and AML/CFT KYC Questionnaire (for the Beneficial Ownership Register)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Licensed Marshall Islands Registered Agent / corporate service provider
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Signature notarization; internal verification by the Registered Agent; consular legalization only when the declaration must be produced to a foreign court, regulator, or financial institution

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter and professional opinion from the UBO's bank (enhanced due diligence for Stripe and Escrow_Pay payment rails)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Correspondent bank or licensed financial institution servicing the beneficial owners
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization and competent authority authentication in the issuing bank's jurisdiction, then consular legalization as applicable for use in the Marshall Islands

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Statement of Non-Resident Status and Tax-Exempt Classification Acknowledgment for the Non-Resident Domestic Business Corporation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Marshall Islands Registrar of Corporations and Ministry of Finance
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Issued domestically by RMI authorities; consular legalization is required only when the statement is relied on before a foreign registry, bank, or e-commerce payment processor

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all UBOs, directors, and authorized signatories against the OFAC SDN and Non-SDN lists, UN Security Council Consolidated List, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, UK HMT Sanctions List, and RMI domestic terrorist designations. PEP status triggers enhanced due diligence: documented source of wealth and source of funds, senior-management approval, and 24-month transaction monitoring. Re-screening is required every 90 days and upon any material change. For the ISIC 4791 vintage-luxury online resale model, typology screening addresses trade-based money laundering, consignment fraud, high-value goods over/under-invoicing, and sanctions evasion routed through Stripe and Escrow_Pay channels.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Marshall Islands Corporate Registry — Office of the Registrar of Corporations (Ministry of Commerce), name-clearance and reservation database operated through licensed Registered Agents
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Under Section 112 of the Business Corporations Act, the corporate name must be in Roman (Latin) script and must contain a recognized corporate suffix (Corporation, Incorporated, Company, Limited, or approved abbreviation such as Corp., Inc., Co., Ltd.). Names in non-Roman scripts (Cyrillic, CJK, Arabic, etc.) are registered only in exact transliteration, certified by the authorized filer; the foreign-script form may be used only as an unprotected trade name. Names must be distinguishable on the record from all existing and reserved RMI entities, and must not misrepresent the company's regulated status.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection, the licensed Registered Agent receives a written Statement of Rejection identifying the conflicting name or prohibited token. Within 14 days, the applicant may file a Request for Reconsideration supported by letters of consent from the conflicting entity, evidence of prior trademark registration, or a ministerial waiver (e.g., Banking Commission consent for Bank/Trust/Insurance tokens). If reconsideration is denied, the applicant may (i) submit a new distinguishable name without further payment, (ii) apply for a 30-day extension of the original reservation before its expiry (cumulative reservation cap not to exceed 90 days), or (iii) seek administrative review before the High Court of the Marshall Islands under general administrative-law principles of the RMI.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Virtual office acceptance is limited: the statutory registered office must be the physical street address of the licensed Registered Agent in the Marshall Islands (Majuro or Ebeye), and no physical RMI operating office is required. For this vintage luxury resale e-commerce business, however, Stripe and Escrow_Pay onboarding will require a verifiable operational address and commercial substance in the supported market region; a mailbox-only virtual office is not acceptable for AML/KYC record-keeping or for the Registered Agent's obligation to produce original statutory books to the Banking Commission on request.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low for the corporate registry itself (estimated below 5% per annum); elevated supervision risk (estimated 25-40% per annum) is directed at the licensed Registered Agent under APG/FATF follow-up, with unannounced on-site inspections possible at the agent's premises. The company's offshore operations are not directly inspected because no physical RMI office exists; enforcement occurs through the agent, correspondent banks, and payment-rail KYC controls.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory filing tariff under the Registrar's consolidated government fee schedule

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Registrar of Corporations / Ministry of Finance
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory annual fee tariff, minimum authorized-capital band

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed Marshall Islands Registered Agent (corporate service provider)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed Registered Agent / appointed AML compliance officer
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for enhanced due diligence at Medium_Risk_Enhanced tier

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization and consular legalization bundle for documents executed outside the RMI (including RMI Embassy Washington, D.C. certification)

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market legalization benchmark plus RMI consular tariff

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Competent authentication authorities of the document-origin jurisdiction

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Business Corporations Act 1990, Marshall Islands Revised Code (Kajoor), Title 51, Sections 31, 32, 44 and 48.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Commercial Registry, Ministry of Finance, Majuro, Republic of the Marshall Islands
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital; shares may be issued for such consideration as the Board determines, and no escrow account is required by law.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the Board hereby adopts the Articles of Incorporation and accepts the subscriber's application for issuance of one hundred (100) common shares in consideration of $1,000 deposited to the corporate account, and that the shares be recorded as fully paid; RESOLVED, that the registered office be established at the address of the resident agent, Majuro, Marshall Islands; RESOLVED, that the Secretary of the Corporation be appointed as initial officer, with authority to execute banking resolutions and maintain statutory records; and that the Board ratifies all incorporation filings.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Name reservation and registered agent engagement
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Corporations (electronic portal via licensed resident agent)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a name reservation application through a licensed registered agent, accompanied by the agent's written consent to act and the proposed director's name and address. The Registrar will check availability against the corporate names database and issue a reservation certificate valid for 30 days.
required_dossiers: Written consent of licensed resident agent
Proposed director's name, nationality, and address
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected or confusingly similar, file an amended reservation with at least two alternate names; no additional state fee applies if the resubmission is made within 10 calendar days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upload the executed Articles of Incorporation, together with the name reservation certificate and registered agent acceptance, through the Registry's e-filing platform. Pay the statutory filing fee and await issuance of the Certificate of Incorporation.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a deficiency notice is issued, submit a curative amendment through the registered agent within 14 days; if the defect relates to an illegible signature, a notarized joinder must be filed.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Organization meeting and initial governance records
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Board of Directors (corporate statutory seat at registered agent's office)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene the organization meeting or execute unanimous written consents adopting the bylaws, approving the share issue, and appointing officers. Record minutes in the corporate records book.
required_dossiers: Written consent in lieu of organization meeting
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a signature is delinquent or not witnessed, the by-laws provide for a ratifying meeting of the Board within 30 days; an omitted officer may be appointed by a later written resolution.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed financial institution in the Marshall Islands or an approved offshore bank
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a corporate bank account using the Certificate of Incorporation, the Board Resolution, and the registered agent certificate. Deposit the subscribed capital contribution and obtain a certificate of deposit for the corporate records.
required_dossiers: First Board Resolution on account opening
Registered agent certificate of good standing
Passport copies of the beneficial owner and signatories
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank requests enhanced due diligence, provide a completed source-of-wealth statement and certified corporate register extract; escalated AML review may extend the timeline by 5 additional business days.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not engaged – no industrial licensing board jurisdiction over e-commerce/resale activities
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not applicable – no statutory operating license required for non-resident online retail

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt – Category C (no physical facility, fabricating process, or land disturbance)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not applicable; no industrial wastewater, VOC emissions, or regulated waste streams. General obligations for office e-waste disposal and ozone-depleting substances, if applicable, remain subject to RMIEPA monitoring under Title 24 MIRC.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Standard fire safety certificate and building occupancy clearance are required for the registered agent's premises; no worksite-specific occupational clearance applies in the absence of employees or physical premises. If a local storage room is subsequently used, a fire inspection under the RMI Fire Code is recommended.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Tax and Revenue Division, Ministry of Finance, Republic of the Marshall Islands (RMI). The official administrative portal for tax, business license, and customs data exchange is the RMI government financial services portal operated by the Ministry of Finance; the corporate registry is administered by the Registrar of Corporations.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign-owned Business Corporation does not obtain a VAT ID because the RMI has no VAT. It obtains an RMI Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN) only when a statutory local contact point exists (customs account, business license, payroll, real estate, or financial account). The SOP is: (1) file the certificate of incorporation and registered-office/registered-agent records; (2) file an RMI Taxpayer Registration application with the Tax and Revenue Division describing non-resident status; (3) if any goods will enter RMI territory, obtain a Customs importer/exporter code; (4) where a business is actually carried on in RMI, file the Business License Registration and obtain the annual license-tax stamp; and (5) receive the TIN certificate as the statutory identifier for customs, banking, and tax filings.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: The Marshall Islands income tax system does not administer U.S.-style check-the-box elections or OECD hybrid-mismatch elections. The operative statutory election is the entry into Non-Resident Domestic Corporation status under the Business Corporations Act, which confirms exclusion from RMI net-income tax on non-RMI-source income and exemption from Business License Tax for offshore gross revenue. An additional election may be made for a project-specific Tax Exemption Certificate under the RMI development-incentive legislation. No election exists to convert the entity into a pass-through vehicle for RMI tax purposes; RMI law respects entity-level classification as stated in the BCA.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: No VAT, GST, or sales-and-use tax is levied in the RMI. The indirect tax architecture consists of Customs Import Duty and ad valorem tariffs under the Customs Tariff Act, plus the annual Business License Tax, which is imposed on categories of gross revenue rather than as a transaction-level VAT/GST.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Not applicable for a VAT/GST registration threshold because the RMI does not impose VAT/GST. Customs registration is compulsory for any person importing commercial goods. Business License Tax registration is required for a business carried on in RMI; a Non-Resident Domestic Corporation with no RMI-source gross revenue is outside that regime. The RMI uses the United States Dollar as legal tender, so all local-currency references are in USD.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: The RMI does not operate a real-time fiscal e-invoicing API, digital stamping, or transaction clearance mandate. Customs entries are processed through the electronic customs clearance system maintained by RMI Customs; the system issues an electronic release/clearance for each declaration. Private commercial invoices are not subject to prior government clearance outside customs.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Because no VAT/GST applies in the RMI, there is no 0% export VAT rate to claim. A Non-Resident Domestic Corporation operating online secondhand-luxury resale is treated as having no RMI indirect tax exposure where sales, payment processing, and delivery are performed outside RMI. For physical goods exported from RMI that had previously been imported, the relevant relief is customs duty drawback or re-export exemption under the Customs Tariff Act, available where the goods are identifiable, exported within the statutory period, and supported by customs entry documentation.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration with electronic customs release
Bill of Lading or Airway Bill as evidence of international transportation
Commercial invoice and packing list describing the vintage/luxury goods, quantities, and export value
Customs import entry and duty receipt if a duty drawback or re-export exemption is claimed
Inward remittance statement or bank payment records evidencing the foreign sales proceeds
Powers of attorney or consignment manifests where applicable
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The Tax and Revenue Division and RMI Customs may audit export documentation, customs duty drawback claims, and non-resident gross-revenue declarations. Fraudulent export or drawback documentation attracts forfeiture or seizure of goods, retrospective cancellation of the exemption, assessment of unpaid duty/tax with interest, monetary penalties (up to USD 10,000 per violation and additional penalty of up to 250% of the duty/tax assessed), and criminal liability for willful false declarations. The non-resident exemption may be reopened within the general six-year limitation period if revenue was mischaracterized as non-RMI source, with a 50% civil fraud penalty and loss of exemption status.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Marshall Islands uses the U.S. dollar as its official legal tender; accordingly, there are no separate domestic capital controls or current account convertibility restrictions. Profit remittance fees and statutory withholding taxes (e.g., nonresident withholding on dividends and royalties) apply, but no exchange control approval is required for capital flows because the economy is fully dollarized. Businesses with nonresident bank accounts may freely receive and disburse USD without central bank conversion mandates, subject to suspicious transaction reporting and corresponding U.S. OFAC sanctions screening.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No statutory timeline or mandatory conversion ratio applies to export receipts in the Marshall Islands due to the absence of a domestic currency and the absence of exchange control legislation. Receipts may be held in U.S. dollars indefinitely in any licensed commercial bank. However, reporting thresholds under the Financial Transactions Reporting Act (as amended) require banks to file currency transaction reports for cash transactions exceeding USD 10,000 and suspicious activity reports, and to maintain full underlying trade documentation for audit and lender compliance purposes.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: Medium with significant legal constraints. Offshore digital EMI providers are not licensed or regulated by the Marshall Islands Financial Institutions Commission and cannot provide domestic clearing or local account numbers; however, a non-resident Business Corporation may maintain a USD settlement account with a U.S.-chartered fintech or an EMI operating under a U.S. state money transmitter license, provided the entity passes KYC and the EMI offers banking-as-a-service that complies with U.S. sanctions and anti-money laundering regulations. Such accounts are treated as foreign accounts and do not satisfy local documentary requirements for escrow or corporate bank references.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence and KYC interview mandate: Directors are not required to appear physically in the Marshall Islands for bank account opening. Most tier-1 commercial banks and U.S. correspondent banks require either a video KYC interview with the beneficial owner and all signatories, or a notarized offshore corporate resolution package plus certified passport copies and proof of address. Fully remote opening is generally permitted for non-resident entities if the ultimate beneficial owner is an individual from a compliant jurisdiction and the corporate registry is verified electronically through the Office of the Registrar of Marshall Islands Corporations.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-risk jurisdiction or PEP status of beneficial owner or directors
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Independent net-worth verification by a licensed CPA/CFA, source-of-wealth statement, reference letters from an existing regulated bank in the owner's domicile, and a media/negative-news check report from a recognized screening vendor (Refinitiv, Dow Jones, or LexisNexis).

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Cross-border luxury consignment business classification as high money laundering risk
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Executed consignment agreements, product authentication certificates, valuation reports by accredited gemological or watch/leather appraisal houses, storefront licenses (if any), and a written AML/CTF compliance manual covering risk-based customer due diligence, transaction monitoring, and supply-chain audit trail.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Missing economic substance or lack of physical presence in the Marshall Islands
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: A non-resident corporation immunity certificate under the Marshall Islands Business Corporations Act, proof of registered agent and office, certified copy of articles of incorporation and bylaws, and a written explanation of the commercial rationale for offshore incorporation (e.g., tax neutrality and international e-commerce operations).

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Beneficial ownership disclosure denial or nominee director/owner chains
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Full beneficial ownership structure chart, certified ownership registry report from the registered agent, executed declarations of trust or nominee agreements (if any), and signed indemnities confirming ultimate individual control and tax transparency.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Use of Stripe/Escrow-Pay payment rails for vintage luxury resale merchandise
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Merchant underwriting approval from payment processors, chargeback/seller performance history, escrow service user agreement, insurance certificates for shipped goods, and documented internal controls for authentication, grading, and customer identity verification.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound capital injections are routed via SWIFT MT103 (or Fedwire for domestic U.S. transfers) from the beneficial owner's personal or corporate account to the Marshall Islands entity's USD operational account. Standard U.S. purpose codes (e.g., 'EQUITY' or 'CAPITAL CONTRIBUTION' under the Federal Reserve's Purpose Code for ACH/Fedwire) are used; for SWIFT transfers, the field 70 (Remittance Information) should reference 'SHARE CAPITAL SUBSCRIPTION' or 'CAPITAL INJECTION'. The receiving bank will request a copy of the board resolution approving the issue of shares or capital advance, a certificate of good standing from the Marshall Islands Registrar, and a statement verifying the source of funds.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound trade disbursements for vintage luxury resale settlements are executed primarily via SWIFT MT103 international wire transfers to authenticated supplier or consignor accounts, with corresponding beneficiary bank due diligence. Commercial letters of credit are permissible for large-ticket procuring transactions, issued by a U.S. or Asian issuing bank in favor of the ultimate supplier, with presentation of commercial invoice, certificate of authenticity (if required), bill of lading, and insurance certificate. For escrow-based online resale, funds are cleared through the escrow provider's domestic U.S. settlement rails (ACH or wire) and remitted to the company's operating account. All SWIFT MT103 payment orders must include a concise purpose of payment (e.g., 'GOODS PURCHASE' or 'REIMBURSEMENT OF CONSIGNOR') and must be screened against OFAC and consolidated sanctions lists.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable USD/EUR forwards (for European vintage luxury supply sourcing)
Deliverable USD/GBP forwards (for UK auction-house settlement)
Offshore non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) referencing non-USD currencies where no domestic deliverable market exists
Cross-currency swaps (USD against EUR or GBP) for notional conversion hedging of purchase contracts and resale obligations

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Franchise Tax Return and Corporate Existence Confirmation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Republic of the Marshall Islands (submitted via the licensed registered agent)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before 31 March of each calendar year; no extension is available for non-resident business corporations.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment accrues penalty and interest under the Registrar's schedule; if the default remains uncured after written notice, generally within 90 days, the Registrar may administratively dissolve or strike off the corporation.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Registered Agent Annual Beneficial Ownership (UBO) and KYC Confirmation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Licensed registered agent (maintained under the Marshall Islands Registered Agents Act; no filing is made with the Registrar)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually by 31 March with the franchise tax renewal, and promptly upon any share transfer or beneficial-ownership change.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to provide current UBO/KYC information may cause the registered agent to resign; a corporation that remains without a registered agent following the statutory notice period can be administratively dissolved.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No compulsory statutory audit applies to a non-resident Business Corporation under the Marshall Islands Business Corporations Act; there is no revenue or asset threshold. An audit is mandatory only if the entity is regulated or licensed in an activity such as banking, insurance, or trust services, or if the articles or bylaws voluntarily require it.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: No statutory tax accounting framework is prescribed for non-resident corporations; books may be maintained under IFRS or US GAAP as a prudent internal policy and must sufficiently disclose the corporation's financial affairs, including vintage luxury goods inventory, sales, and escrow receivables.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The Marshall Islands does not maintain a public UBO register and does not require an annual UBO declaration to the Registrar. The licensed registered agent is required to identify and record beneficial owners under AML/KYC law; upon every shareholding transfer, the board must update the Register of Members and the transfer data must be provided to the agent so the UBO record is refreshed. An annual confirmation of the UBO schedule is performed at the 31 March franchise tax renewal as part of the agent's compliance file.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: US$350–US$1,200 per annum, depending on the registered agent and service scope
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: Not statutorily required; voluntary audit generally US$2,500–US$15,000 depending on transaction volume and record completeness

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Zero-effective-tax jurisdiction for non-resident business corporations; no corporate income tax, no capital gains tax, no withholding tax. The 3% Gross Revenue Tax applies only to trade or business carried on within the Republic; non-resident e-commerce operators deriving no RMI-source revenue fall outside it.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: No corporate income tax return exists. Filing instrument: BCA Annual Report (Form BCA-01) with the Registrar of Corporations, submitted through the RMI Corporate Registry electronic portal.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due on the anniversary of the registration date; if the corporation's fiscal year-end differs, due within 30 days after fiscal year-end.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Exact legal name as per Articles of Incorporation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter full registered legal name; no trade names unless separately registered.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered agent name and street address in the Republic.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Use the licensed RMI registered agent; PO Box only is insufficient.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Authorized capital: share classes, par value, number of shares.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: State USD capital; used for annual franchise tax calculation, not income tax.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Directors and officers: names, addresses, nationalities.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident directors permitted; no RMI residency or citizenship requirement.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Principal place of business in the Republic, if any.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: State 'None' if no RMI office, employees, or physical assets.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Certification of no RMI-source revenue and no trade or business in the Republic.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Sign only if strictly accurate; RMI-source e-commerce sales invalidate this declaration and trigger GRT.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing: USD 100 per month up to USD 500; administrative strike-off after 90 days; stricken entity loses legal standing and certificate of good standing. Reinstatement requires arrears plus reinstatement fee.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: No domestic withholding tax, so no internal relief procedure. To benefit from foreign tax treaty reductions, apply to the Registrar for a Tax Residency Certificate (TRC) with certificate of incorporation, annual filing receipt, registered agent letter, and USD 250 fee; submit TRC to the foreign payer with a self-certification (e.g., IRS Form W-8BEN-E).
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory RMI rate: 0% for both royalties and interest. The RMI has no comprehensive DTA network; treaty-reduced rates depend on the foreign payer's jurisdiction and are not RMI-imposed.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Not applicable; no RMI transfer-pricing statute. Currency: USD. Prudent benchmark: prepare Local File when annual related-party transactions exceed USD 1,000,000; Master File when group consolidated revenue exceeds USD 50,000,000.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: RMI Economic Substance Regulations (ESR) apply to non-resident companies carrying on relevant activities in the Republic. ISIC 4791 online luxury consignment is generally not a relevant activity unless it operates as a distribution/service center for connected persons; a nil ESR notification and annual return must still be filed. Failure to comply triggers USD 10,000 penalty; repeat failure USD 50,000 and strike-off.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion / Misdeclaration of RMI Source
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Falsely certifying no RMI-source revenue while selling to RMI residents or conducting business in the Republic, or concealing beneficial ownership before foreign tax authorities.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under Title 60 of the Marshall Islands Revised Code: felony, imprisonment up to 5 years, individual fine up to USD 5,000, corporate fine up to USD 25,000, plus restitution and revocation of charter.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who authorize the false declaration are jointly and severally liable; corporate veil pierced, civil restitution, travel bans, and possible extradition.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating as a pure shell with no RMI physical presence, employees, local management, or record-keeping, and failing to file ESR notification and substance returns.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: ESR penalties: USD 10,000 first failure, USD 50,000 subsequent failures; deregistration and name transmitted to EU/OECD as non-compliant shell.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors personally liable for unpaid penalties; disqualification from RMI directorships up to 10 years; travel restrictions and contempt sanctions.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Processing proceeds from stolen, counterfeit, or fraud-scanned luxury goods without KYC, provenance verification, or suspicious transaction reporting via the escrow/payment rails.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: RMI AML Act: fines up to USD 1,000,000, asset seizure, business suspension, and imprisonment up to 15 years for controlling individuals.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Willful blindness to red flags triggers personal criminal liability; disgorgement, freezing orders, travel bans, and extradition under mutual legal assistance.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Holding customer funds as escrow agent or operating as a payment intermediary without a RMI money transmission license.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Administrative cease-and-desist, forced restitution, fine of USD 25,000 per day of violation, and criminal prosecution for customer fraud.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors deemed trustees of customer funds; misuse results in personal liability for full restitution, bank account freezing, travel bans, and imprisonment.
